# Jersey Elite Coatings

> Premier epoxy flooring and concrete coating company serving all of North Jersey. Licensed & insured, locally owned, installing since 2010. Services include garage epoxy flooring, metallic & decorative epoxy, full-broadcast flake systems, commercial epoxy, industrial floor coatings, basement epoxy, and restaurant kitchen flooring. Every floor is backed by a lifetime warranty against peeling and delamination.

## Key facts
- Service area: All of North Jersey — Newark, Jersey City, Hoboken, Clifton, Paterson, Montclair, Wayne, West Orange, Livingston, Ridgewood, Paramus, Morristown, and surrounding Essex, Hudson, Bergen, Passaic & Morris County towns.
- Method: Diamond grinding surface preparation on every floor, 100% solids epoxy and polyaspartic systems, moisture testing before basement installs.
- Credentials: Licensed & insured in New Jersey. Free on-site quotes with color & flake samples. Lifetime warranty against peeling and delamination.
- Pricing: Residential epoxy typically $3–8 per sq ft installed; a 2-car garage (≈400 sq ft) runs $1,200–$3,200. Metallic systems $7–12 per sq ft.
- Phone: (973) 378-1192 · Email: info@jerseyelitecoatings.com
